Mesmo conjunto do count_neighborhoods le: Same set as in legacy count_neighborhoods: cell intact at the start, known left/above/below neighbors with at least one active (000 excluded), known final state. Class frozen at the start of each interval; a cell may reappear in later intervals if observed. No exposure beyond the last frame.
Estado final ou vizinhança desconhecidos: Unknown final state or neighborhood: the entire interval is excluded, without imputing survival or partial time; an unknown initial state is outside the at-risk population. An event is observed only within (t_i,t_i+1], not at its exact time; absence of an event contributes survival over Δt. Loss of observation is not treated as demonstrably independent censoring.
sum_event log(1-exp(-lambda*dt)) - sum_n: sum_event log(1-exp(-lambda*dt)) - sum_no_event lambda*dt; constant hazard within each frozen class. Grouped/interval MLE conditional on the observed set; NOT events/sum(dt), which would require exact event times/appropriate exposure times.
Com dt=2 uniforme, p=events/exposures e: With uniform dt=2, p=events/exposures and lambda=-log(1-p)/2 are equivalent in the grouped Bernoulli model, not to the exact-time MLE. Classes with fewer than 30 exposures are descriptive only; the operational minimum of 30 remains unchanged.
Sensibilidade descritiva da hipótese tem: Descriptive sensitivity analysis of the temporal assumption, without operational refitting or physical validation. Spatial/temporal dependence, activations within intervals, monotonicity enforcement, and censoring may bias the constant-hazard assumption.
